mapper.select: SELECT warehouse_id AS "warehouseId" , warehouse_cd AS "warehouseCd" , warehouse_nm AS "warehouseNm" , warehouse_type AS "warehouseType" , default_yn AS "defaultYn" , remark AS "remark" , use_yn AS "useYn" FROM tb_warehouse WHERE warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND factory_code = #{factoryCode} AND plant_code = #{plantCode}
SELECT MAX(CAST(warehouse_cd AS INTEGER)) FROM tb_warehouse WHERE warehouse_cd ~ '^[0-9]{6}$'
